{{Quote|Climber. We fought together on Deko Neimoidia.|Climber, to Roan Shryne|<ref name="DarkLord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Deko Neimoidia''' was a wealthy [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was a [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]] of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the possession of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] laid [[Siege of Deko Neimoidia|siege]] to the planet near the end of that conflict, with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led offensive eventually resulting in the devastation and capture of the world.

==Description==
Deko Neimoidia, also referred to simply as Deko, was a terrestrial<ref name="Labyrinth" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DB Cato" /> located in the [[Deko Neimoidia system/Legends|Deko Neimoidia system]] of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It formed a part of [[Neimoidian space]].<ref name="Insider71">{{InsiderCite|71|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition}}</ref>

==History==
===Ruination of a purse world===
{{Quote|A series of strikes led by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker eliminated the remaining Separatist bases on the Neimoidian colonial purse worlds of Cato Neimoidia, Deko Neimoidia, and Koru Neimoidia.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Cody-ssnap.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Clone Marshal Commander Cody encountered a Neimoidian fortress on Deko Neimoidia.]]
Deko Neimoidia was among the most famous of [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]], which were in turn the most prestigious of the hundreds of worlds [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="DB Cato" /> of the Colonies planet [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], both Neimoidia and Deko Neimoidia had become possessions of<ref name="TEA" /> the Neimoidian-controlled<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Eventually, the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legions]] doubled conscription service and called up all reservists for protection of both Neimoidia and the purse worlds, including Deko Neimoidia&mdash;a fact that was noted in a [[21 BBY/Legends|14:10:05]] release of the Confederacy's [[Shadowfeed/Legends|Shadowfeed]] news and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program.<ref name="Insider71" />

Near the end of the Clone Wars, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] moved to eliminate the last remaining Confederacy strongholds in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the Colonies,<ref name="TEA" /> carrying out a [[siege of Deko Neimoidia]].<ref name="Labyrinth" /> The offensive was [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="NEC" /> with Kenobi not visiting any of the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]] located on the planet during his time there. During the siege, Republic forces including [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] also became familiar with the layout of the local Neimoidian [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. Deko Neimoidia was eventually devastated<ref name="Labyrinth" /> and captured by the Republic.<ref name="CSWE" />

===The final month===
[[File:Shryne.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Roan Shryne fought during the siege of Deko Neimoidia.]]
In 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Republic attempted to [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|capture]] the Trade Federation [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who had traveled to the purse world [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in order to loot his [[Nute Gunray's citadel|citadel]] there. At the time, Kenobi mused that, given the fate of both Deko Neimoidia and its fellow captured purse world [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]] as well as the Republic threatening Neimoidia itself, it would have been more rational for Gunray to instead retreat to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] similarly to the actions of other Confederacy leaders. During a tactical discussion held between Kenobi, Skywalker, and Cody as part of the operation, Cody recalled the Republic's experiences on Deko Neimoidia when speculating about the layout of Gunray's citadel.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

When [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Climber (clone)|Climber]] of the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Ion Team]] of the Republic's<ref name="DarkLord" /> [[22nd Air Combat Wing]]<ref name="CSWE 22nd">{{CSWECite|III|205|22nd Air Combat Wing}}</ref> met [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Roan Shryne]] during a [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the Outer Rim planet [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]]<ref name="DarkLord" /> no more than a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later,<ref name="Month">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[siege of Cato Neimoidia]] to no more than a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] before the events of {{Film|III}}, which include the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. In turn, the section of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' where Deko Neimoidia is mentioned is set [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before the execution of said [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|order]].</ref> he reminded the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that they had served together during the fighting on Deko Neimoidia.<ref name="DarkLord" /> The Republic offensive on that purse world was later also noted in the [[36 ABY]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|In response to a decree issued from the Office of the General of the Separatist Army, the Neimoidian Home Defense Legions have doubled conscription service, and called up all reservists for active protection of Neimoidia and the colonial purse-worlds of Deko Neimoidia, Koru Neimoidia and Cato Neimoidia ''[sic]''|Shadowfeed news report|<ref name="Insider71" />}}
Although, like all of the Neimoidian purse worlds, Deko Neimoidia was politically subservient to the [[Trade monarch/Legends|trade monarch]] based on Neimoidia, the former world's influence on interstellar commerce eventually eclipsed that of the latter.<ref name="TEA" /> Deko Neimoidia itself was also developed to the point where it became<ref name="DesperateAllies">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref> extremely wealthy<ref name="CSWE" /> and a more hospitable and desirable destination than Neimoidia.<ref name="DesperateAllies" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Assuming that Gunray's fortress is similar to what we found on Deko and Koru, the underground levels will contain fungus farms and processing and shipment areas.|Cody|<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
Deko Neimoidia was home to large, lavish settlements and palace-like residences of affluent and powerful Neimoidians.<ref name="OSVC33" /> Similarly to Koru Neimoidia, by the time of the Clone Wars Deko Neimoidia also hosted a fortress that featured underground [[fungus farm]]s and processing and shipment areas as well as Neimoidian [[Grub-hatchery|grub hatcheries]] on its mid levels.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deko Neimoidia was first mentioned in "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[CIS Shadowfeed (Insider)|in-universe news report]]. It was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 71|seventy-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider71" /> on [[September 26]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider71 date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/09/news20030924.html|text=Collectors Extravaganza in ''Insider'' #71}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Deko Neimoidia in grid square N-11.<ref name="TEA" />
